mintAuthority.summary: USDD uses direct Maker-style token and Join contracts on Tron, Ethereum, and BSC. Each Join can mint only against existing Vat credit/debt accounting, but self-controlled chain-local GovActionsProxy owner paths can immediately authorize mint rails or remove limits with no independent timelock.

controls.label: USDD Tron Join (active ward / direct minter)
controls.capDescription: UsddJoin.exit first executes vat.move(msg.sender,address(this),ONE*wad) and only then calls usdd.mint. The Join therefore requires pre-existing Vat credit and cannot authorize itself or raise a Vat debt ceiling.
controls.evidence: At Tron block 85180039, token.wards(Join) returned 1 and Join.usdd() returned TXDk8mbtRbXeYuMNS83CfKPaYYT8XWv9Hz. Verified exit() consumes existing Vat credit before minting, and the Join cannot raise system limits or authorize itself.

controls.label: USDD Tron GovActionsProxy (governance executor)
controls.capDescription: The DSAuth-controlled executor can call rely to authorize new token or Vat wards, file to raise system ceilings, and customExec for arbitrary system calls. Its Pause delay is zero.
controls.evidence: Reads ending at Tron block 85180039 returned authority() = zero, owner() = TSF2rqLdrrZG7PZkDxtvu6B2PTpofidMAX, pause() = TNq6E9XsQfrzqVwam67LApZQx1omsj8dyW, and Pause.delay() = 0. Verified source exposes authenticated rely, file, and customExec paths, so this executor can authorize mint rails rather than only changing parameters.

controls.label: USDD Tron GovActionsProxy owner — single-key account (governance executor)
controls.evidence: GovActionsProxy.owner() returned TSF2rqLdrrZG7PZkDxtvu6B2PTpofidMAX and authority() returned zero. TronGrid account data shows both owner and active permissions at threshold 1 with one key, proving a 1-of-1 native account rather than a multisig. DSAuth therefore gives this owner the authenticated governance paths.

review.evidence: Deployment-wide review covered the current Tron, Ethereum, and BSC direct token, Join, GovActionsProxy, and owner paths. Each Join consumes existing Vat credit before minting, but each chain's self-controlled GovActionsProxy owner can immediately authorize new wards, raise or remove system limits, and execute arbitrary system calls with no independent timelock; the economic cap is therefore unbounded rather than independently raiseable. Ethereum and BSC use the same owner EOA, while Tron uses a verified 1-of-1 native account. The tracked token and Join contracts are direct non-proxy deployments. USDD creates an on-chain collateral and Vat claim rather than an off-chain reserve claim, so reconciliation is not-applicable. No public mint-control incident or prudential issuer regime was identified.
